# Fixture Clean V3 README

## Status
Research only. This fixture does not change Factory v2 behavior and is not enforced.

Factory v2 remains the usable process with stage order `A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> F -> G -> H -> I -> J -> I2`.

Factory v3 should be AEGIS-compatible but not AEGIS-dependent. AEGIS is not required.

Factory v3 release or promotion requires evidence and explicit human release approval.
